caption: today's sky: the moon is still in leo after yesterday's full moon, and mercury sextiles venus.

slides.headline: the morning after the *full moon*. the *moon*'s still in leo
slides.dek: and the follow-up text is blessed

slides.headline: still loud, a bit *softer*
slides.body: the moon is waning in leo. read it as the day to be generous about what got said last night.

slides.headline: *mercury* sextile venus: say the nice thing
slides.body: an easy aspect for kind words. if last night went well, tell them. if it didn't, tell them kindly.
